_about: Customer-facing wording for proposal lines. Lifetime warranty goes ONLY on full installs (see rules.md). Keep lines short: no 'haul away debris' style filler.

warranty.lifetime: Covered by the Ridgeline Home Exteriors Lifetime Workmanship Warranty (see warranty terms).
warranty.paint: One coat applied in two passes. Paint workmanship covers missed coverage found within the first year.
warranty.manufacturer: Manufacturer warranty from {maker}; registering it is the customer's responsibility.{links} Manufacturer defects aren't covered by our workmanship warranty, and labor is charged on manufacturer-defect repairs.
warranty.stuccoColorMatch: Stucco repairs can't be perfectly color-matched to the existing wall.

manufacturers._about: Links shown on proposal lines come ONLY from the manufacturer's own website. 'verified' is set to true once Sean has confirmed the maker's process and links. 'note' replaces the standard manufacturer sentence for makers with their own process ({links} is filled with the links). No link is better than a guessed one.

lp._process: LP has no homeowner registration. For a claim LP needs a letter from RHX on company letterhead stating the install month/date and our GC license number, so the customer contacts RHX for it.
lp.note: Manufacturer warranty from LP Building Solutions. No registration is needed; if you ever need to file a claim, contact Ridgeline Home Exteriors and we'll provide the installation letter LP requires.{links} Manufacturer defects aren't covered by our workmanship warranty, and labor is charged on manufacturer-defect repairs.
